title: Plant extraction for LC-MS Analysis
author: Tito Damiani
materials: Grind the material to obtain a powder

steps.title: Collect and Transport Plant Material
steps.instruction: Collect fresh plant material (leaf, root, stem, flower, fruit) and transport it to the lab.

substeps.instruction: Collect a portion of fresh plant material into a 50 mL Falcon tube
Put the tubes in dry ice immediately for transportation to the lab

steps.title: Lyophilize Plant Material
steps.instruction: Prepare and lyophilize the collected plant material.

substeps.instruction: Cover the top and sides of the tube with one piece of thin net fabric
Attach the fabric to the tube with a rubber band
Insert the tubes into the lyophiliser flasks
Run the lyophilisation for 3 days (following lyophiliser instructions)

steps.title: Grind and Store Material
steps.instruction: Process the lyophilized material into a powder and store it.

substeps.instruction: Insert all the lyophilised material into a lab grinder
Store the material in a dry room in a tightly closed Falcon tube

steps.title: Prepare Extraction Samples
steps.instruction: Weigh the lyophilized material and prepare for extraction.

substeps.instruction: Weight 25 ± 2.5 mg of lyophilized plant material into a 2.0 Eppendorf tube with round bottom
Add a metal bead to each tube
Add 2 000 μL of DMSO (HPLC grade) and vortex to mix

steps.title: Prepare Samples for LC-MS
steps.instruction: Transfer the extract and dilute it for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 10 μL of supernatant into LC-MS vials with insert
Add 90 μL of CH3CN-H2O solution (50:50, v/v)
